summary:
Iteration 7 (staff/driver auth, driver system, closing/sources reports, operational ticket, concurrency) validated end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend: 29/29 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_staff_driver_iter7.py (run with -n 0). Frontend: all 12 requested flows working. FOUND 1 CRITICAL BACKEND BUG: unique index on orders.client_request_id treats null as a duplicate, so the SECOND non-idempotent phone order (no client_request_id) 500s with DuplicateKeyError E11000 dup key: {client_request_id: null}. Tests work around by always sending a fresh client_request_id; the frontend already generates one per attempt so the UI works, but any API caller that omits the field will fail after the first null insert.

Backend covered: (1) staff auth: all 6 PINs -> correct role JWT + label; wrong PIN 401; /me returns role; /reports/closing no-token 401, driver token 403, manager 200; PUT /pins as kitchen 403, as manager driver3->3334 -> login 3334 OK, restored to 3333. (2) FLOW A web delivery: POST /orders (Marg 50cm + Coca) -> pending; /accept -> accepted+printed; double accept -> 400; /assign Livreur 1 -> driver+assigned_at; driver1 /orders lists it; driver2 /orders does NOT; driver2 /depart -> 403; driver1 pickup->picked_up_at, depart->status=delivering + out_for_delivery_at + last notification body.fr='Votre commande est en livraison.'; GET /orders/{id} returns delivering to public; delivered->delivered_at; collect method:cash -> payment_collected=true collection_method=cash; /reports/closing Livreur 1 deliveries>=1 & cash_expected>=order.total. (3) FLOW B pickup ios: accept -> preparing -> ready (ready_at set) -> attempt 'preparing' -> 409 (correctly); then picked_up -> completed. (4) FLOW C: /customers/search 0791751450 returns Anna Rossi account; POST /phone-orders station 1 delivery pay_at_delivery for existing customer -> accepted, printed=true, print_attempts=1; assign Livreur 2 -> driver2 depart+delivered. (5) FLOW D: POST /customers new unique phone (0796...) + POST /phone-orders station 2 cash -> collection_method=cash, amount_due==total; assign Livreur 3; driver3 depart/delivered/collect; /reports/closing Livreur 3 cash_expected >= total; POST /reports/closing actual_cash=expected-10 -> subsequent GET shows cash_difference == -10.0. (6) FLOW E: Diavola 32cm + Nero d'Avola -> age_required=16, vat_breakdown contains 2.6 and 8.1, receipt has 'TVA 2.6%', 'TVA 8.1%', 'CHE-156.631.035 TVA', net+vat==total, ticket has 'ALCOOL - CONTROLE AGE 16+'. (7) TICKET: delivery Flow D ticket has 'L I V R A I S O N', 'Source: TELEPHONE - POSTE', 'CLIENT:', 'ADRESSE:', 'Recue:', 'Acceptee:', 'L I V R E U R' block, 'PAYE / RIEN A ENCAISSER' after collect, '[QR LIVREUR]', '/driver?o=<id>', 'Ticket operationnel'; qr response field == '/driver?o=<id>'; last_print_error/printnode_job_id/printer_configured keys present. Fresh terminal delivery -> ticket contains 'TERMINAL CHF'; fresh cash delivery -> ticket contains 'A ENCAISSER CHF' and 'ESPECES'. Pickup order ticket -> qr null and text contains 'R E T R A I T'. (8) CONCURRENCY: same phone-order body with client_request_id posted twice -> same order_number; only 1 kitchen print_job for that order; two parallel phone orders on stations 1/2 with distinct client_request_id -> distinct order_numbers; reprint without force after Flow D printed once -> 409; assign Livreur 2 after Livreur 1 pickup -> 409. (9) SOURCES: GET /reports/sources (manager) -> 4 buckets incl 'TÉLÉPHONE · POSTE 1' and 'TÉLÉPHONE · POSTE 2' with count+total each.

Frontend covered (1180x820, Expo web): /staff/login PIN 2222 -> /driver, driver-title='Livreur 2', 7 driver-order-* cards, driver-pay-<id>='À ENCAISSER: CHF 31.00 Espèces'; on a freshly-seeded assigned card, driver-depart-<id> click -> card shows 'En livraison'; driver-delivered-<id> -> card shows 'Livrée'; driver-collect-<id> -> card shows 'Encaissé'; navigating to /staff as driver2 -> redirected to /driver. PIN 2345 (kitchen) -> /staff dashboard, NO staff-go-admin/staff-go-closing; navigating to /staff/admin -> redirected back to /staff. PIN 1234 (manager) -> /staff, staff-go-closing visible; click -> /staff/closing, closing-title + closing-Livreur-1/2/3 + sources-report visible; closing-actual-cash-1 filled + closing-save-1 clicked (no error). PIN 3456 -> /phone-orders (station picker Poste 1/2 visible). Manager /phone-orders search 0791751450 -> 1 phone-result-*; select -> phone-change-customer visible -> click clears phone-search-input (value=''); re-typing same '0791751450' -> 1 phone-result-* appears immediately and phone-new-customer form NOT shown (previous iter6 integration bug is FIXED). /staff/ticket/<delivery id> -> ticket-qr visible + ticket-text contains 'Ticket operationnel'. /staff/admin -> admin-go-security -> 6 security-role-* rows visible. Only console noise: RN 'shadow*' deprecated style warnings (cosmetic).

critical.endpoint: POST /api/phone-orders (and any POST /api/orders that stores client_request_id=None)
critical.issue: MongoDB unique index on orders.client_request_id (created sparse) does not exclude documents where the field is explicitly null. Second phone order without client_request_id -> 500 pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError E11000 dup key: {client_request_id: null}. Repro: POST /api/phone-orders twice without client_request_id -> 1st ok, 2nd 500. Fix: recreate the index with partialFilterExpression={'client_request_id': {'$type': 'string'}} (drop the current index first) OR always omit the key from the insert doc when None. See /app/backend/server.py:493 (index creation) + /app/backend/server.py:879-885 (insert always sets client_request_id).

minor.issue: Attempting to move a completed pickup order back to 'preparing' returns 400 'Order already closed' instead of the spec-requested 409. Going back from 'ready' to 'preparing' correctly returns 409. Consider aligning terminal-state guard to 409 for consistency.

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' – RN 0.76+ deprecates shadowColor/Offset/Opacity/Radius. Cosmetic but should migrate to boxShadow. Grep the codebase for 'shadowColor'/'shadowOffset' in StyleSheet.create() blocks.

action_items: CRITICAL – Fix orders.client_request_id unique index so multiple docs with null value are allowed. Recommended: replace the sparse index with a partial one: db.orders.create_index('client_request_id', unique=True, partialFilterExpression={'client_request_id': {'$type': 'string'}}); make sure to db.orders.drop_index('client_request_id_1') first at startup. Alternatively, in create_phone_order / create_order, only insert client_request_id into the doc when it is not None.
Minor – Consider returning 409 (not 400 'Order already closed') when POST /orders/{id}/status attempts to move a completed order backwards, matching the concurrency contract.
Minor – Migrate deprecated shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow to silence RN warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: staff_auth.py: login iterates ALL staff_auth docs on every attempt and Argon2-verifies each pin – O(N=6) hashes per login. Acceptable at this scale; consider indexing hash prefix or caching if PINs grow.
server.py assign_driver: 400 for the 'wrong current status' vs 409 for 'already picked up' is well distinguished. Good.
server.py driver_orders query uses 14h window for delivered_at – reasonable for end-of-day. Note this returns closed orders again if within 14h; the driver UI seems to handle it via 'compact/paid'.
server.py reports/closing uses day_range with local TZ correctly; group by driver name (not role) is robust.

server.py build_ticket: spaced-letter big() uses ' '.join(text) → 'LIVRAISON' becomes 'L I V R A I S O N'. Correct. The 'L I V R E U R  N' block uses two spaces between LIVREUR and N because big(driver.upper()) with 'LIVREUR 1' produces 'L I V R E U R   1' (three interior spaces between R and 1 because ' '.join keeps 'R', ' ', '1' → 'R   1'). Spec-compatible with substring assertion 'L I V R E U R'.

server.py /orders/{id}/print: unique index bug (see above) is orthogonal but blocks the idempotency contract for /orders too since compute_order + insert copies client_request_id=None from PhoneOrderIn body defaults.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created ~10 TEST_* customers (0796XXXXXXX) and their phone/normal orders (Flow A/B/C/D/E + reassign + terminal ticket + parallel + idempotency test orders). Frontend session seeded 1 additional Livreur 2 delivery (order #194) for depart/delivered/collect UI test. All data prefixed TEST_ or bearing 0796 phone numbers – non-destructive, safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest backend/tests/test_staff_driver_iter7.py -n 0 -v (must be serial – shares module STATE). The CRITICAL client_request_id null-dup bug is currently worked-around in the tests by always sending a fresh client_request_id; when the main agent fixes the index, drop those workaround lines to also exercise the null path. Reusable testIDs: driver-title, driver-order-<id>, driver-pay-<id>, driver-pickup/depart/delivered/collect/map/call-<id>, driver-lock, driver-offline; closing-title, closing-Livreur-1/2/3, closing-cash-1, closing-total-1, closing-actual-cash-1/2/3, closing-actual-terminal-1/2/3, closing-save-1/2/3, sources-report; staff-pin-input, staff-pin-submit, staff-go-closing, staff-go-admin, admin-go-security, security-role-<role>; ticket-qr, ticket-text. Login PINs verified: manager 1234, kitchen 2345, phone 3456, driver1 1111, driver2 2222, driver3 3333.
rca_of_issue: The unique index for phone-order idempotency was created as sparse (server.py:493). MongoDB's 'sparse' only excludes documents where the field is absent from the BSON, not where the field is explicitly stored as null. server.py:879-885 always includes 'client_request_id': body.client_request_id (which is None when omitted by callers) in the insert doc – so after the first null insert, every subsequent null insert triggers E11000. Mitigation: (a) drop & recreate as partial index (partialFilterExpression={'client_request_id': {'$type':'string'}}), or (b) $unset when None. The frontend generates a fresh uuid per attempt so end-users are not affected today, but any external API caller (e.g. iOS app, curl) that omits the field will fail after the very first null-key doc lands.
